cs.t: Sorry, BIL == "Buy It for Life". Jansport will repair or replace any damaged backpack, forever, even after they no longer manufacture that style. If they don't make the style anymore and it needs to be replaced, they'll replace it with an equivalent. I love this backpack and there aren't any drawbacks that I've noticed. I carry it everyday and have done so for a little over a year now.
